description: Show content on one screen, or on one sub-screen of a split screen, in place of what it shows now, until a time or until it is put back to normal. A split screen needs a subscreen_id. Returns what the screen shows afterwards. Content only appears once the screen is online and has a player paired; the result includes online and paired when the connection may read screens.

content_id.description: Id of the file, design, app, split screen or playlist to show, as found in the team's content.

screen_id.description: Id of the screen, as listed with the team's screens.

subscreen_id.description: Id of one sub-screen of a split screen. Required for a split screen, left out for a normal screen.

until.description: When to go back to normal: local time of the account without an offset (for example 2026-10-23T18:00), or a time with an offset (2026-10-23T18:00:00+02:00). At most 90 days ahead. Leave out to show it until it is put back to normal.

name: push_content
title: Show content on a screen
